name: Money Masters Leasing & Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Money Masters Leasing 
and Finance Ltd is registered as a Non-Banking Finance Company – Asset Financing Company[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) MMLFL provides loans to individuals for personal use, domestic appliances, and asset purchases
b) The company offers hire-purchase loans for vehicles and equipment, contributing 
over 80% of the total turnover
c) It also funds small and medium enterprises and startup businesses for machinery and consumer goods intended for commercial activity

pros: Stock is trading at 0.60 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.51% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.02% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
